BMI_Clinical_Note: BMI 18.5–22.9 (Indian normal) — Maintain weight. Anti-cancer diet focus.
Bone_Density_Concern: MODERATE — Post-menopausal bone loss. DEXA screening. Calcium + Vit D + weight-bearing exercise.
Nutrition_Impact_Symptoms: Alopecia; Fatigue; Nausea; Taste Changes/Chemosensory Alteration; Vomiting
Nutritional_Status: Well Nourished — Standard Indian Breast Cancer Diet
Zinc_mg_per_day: 10 mg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020) — important for immune function + wound healing
Dietary_Fibre_g_per_day: 40 g/day (ICMR-NIN 2020); reduce to 25 g if diarrhoea/mucositis
Omega3_Recommendation: 2–3 g EPA/DHA/day — fish oil supplement [ESPEN B5-7]
Protein_Source_Note: Vegetarian protein: dal+rice combo (complete AA), paneer, curd, soya, moong, rajma, chickpeas, tofu, amaranth
Alcohol_Guidance: ZERO alcohol — carcinogen; increases BC recurrence risk [ESPEN C5-2]
ICMR_NIN_2020_Reference: ICMR-NIN Nutrient Requirements & RDA for Indians (2020 revision)
Nutrition_Route_ESPEN: Oral Indian home-cooked diet + dietary counselling; ONS if insufficient [ESPEN B3-1]
Supplement_Recommendation: Omega-3 / EPA 2–3 g/day (algae-based DHA if vegetarian) [ESPEN B5-7] — lean mass + neuropathy protection; Calcium 600–1000 mg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020) + Vitamin D 400–800 IU/day — endemic Vit D deficiency in India; Vitamin B12 1–2 mcg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020) or 500 mcg/week cyanocobalamin — B12 deficiency common in Indian vegetarians; Algae-based DHA 200–500 mg/day (omega-3 for vegetarian Indian BC patients); Iron 19–29 mg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020) — monitor Hb; IV iron if <8 g/dL on chemo; Folate 220–400 mcg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020; higher during chemo); Ground flaxseed 1–2 tbsp/day (lignans — phytoestrogen modulation; beneficial ER+ Indian BC survivors); Multivitamin/mineral at RDA dose ONLY (ICMR-NIN 2020). NOT high-dose. Avoid selenium, Vit E, Vit C megadoses during chemo.
Exercise_Plan_ESPEN_India: Aerobic: Brisk walk 45 min/day OR 150–300 min/week (cycling, swimming, Zumba, yoga) [ESPEN B4-1/C5-1]; Resistance: 2–3x/week, 8–12 reps, major muscle groups; can use resistance bands/body weight at home [ESPEN B4-2]; Yoga: 3–5x/week (Suryanamaskar, Pranayama, Shavasana) — evidence for fatigue reduction + cortisol in Indian BC survivors; TARGET: 150–300 min/week moderate activity — reduces Indian BC recurrence risk and improves overall survival
ESPEN_Guidelines_India: 📋 SCREENING [B1-1]: Regular nutritional assessment from diagnosis. Indian BC patients — ICMR/WHO Asian BMI cut-offs apply (Normal: 18.5–22.9; Overweight: ≥23; Obese: ≥25). [North India (UP/Delhi/Punjab/Haryana)] | ⚡ ENERGY [B2-1]: 25–30 kcal/kg/day (ESPEN). Indian context: average Indian BC woman body weight 55–65 kg. Total: 1400–2000 kcal/day depending on stage and activity. | 🥩 PROTEIN [B2-2]: >1 g/kg/day (ESPEN); ICMR-NIN 2020 RDA: 0.83 g/kg/day (healthy); BC treatment: 1.0–1.5 g/kg/day. Vegetarian patients: dal+rice+dairy combination essential for complete amino acid profile. | 💊 MICRONUTRIENTS [B2-4 + ICMR-NIN 2020]: Vitamin D (endemic deficiency in India — 400–1000 IU/day), Calcium (600–1200 mg/day from ragi/dairy/sesame), Iron (19–29 mg/day), Folate (220–400 mcg/day). AVOID high-dose antioxidants during chemo. | 🥗 NUTRITION [B3-1]: Maintain intake. Plant-based Indian diet with protein. No restrictive diets. ZERO alcohol. | 💉 CHEMO [C3-1/C3-2]: Maintain intake during all cycles. Common Indian patient challenge: nausea reducing dal/sabzi intake. Small frequent meals; ginger/ajwain/saunf for nausea. ONS if <75% intake. | 🐟 OMEGA-3 [B5-7]: 2–3 g EPA/day (fish oil or algae-based for vegetarians) — reduces chemo toxicity, preserves lean mass, protective against neuropathy. | ❌ [C3-3]: No glutamine. No high-dose antioxidants during chemotherapy. | 🏃 SURVIVOR [C5-1/C5-2]: Regular PA strongly recommended — 150–300 min/week. Mediterranean-Indian hybrid diet. ZERO alcohol. Maintain BMI 18.5–22.9 (Indian cut-offs). Yoga beneficial for Indian survivors. | 🏋 EXERCISE [B4-1/B4-2]: Aerobic + resistance training recommended. Yoga as adjunct for Indian patients (evidence for fatigue, QoL, cortisol reduction). Lymphedema: progressive resistance IS SAFE. | ❌ BEWARE: High-dose supplement marketing targeting Indian cancer patients (social media/WhatsApp) — vitamin megadoses, 'cancer-curing' supplements, unproven herbal products — not recommended without oncologist approval [ESPEN B2-4].
Diet_Chart_Indian_Meal_Plan: 🌅 Breakfast: Amaranth (rajgira) porridge with low-fat milk + jaggery (small, 1 tsp) + 5 almonds + 1 fruit | Amaranth: complete protein + calcium || 🕙 Mid-Morning: Coconut water (1 glass, electrolytes) + 1 banana + 5 almonds (Vit E) || 🍽 Lunch: 1 cup brown rice + sambhar (lentil+drumstick — calcium + iron) + 2 vegetable sides (beans + methi/fenugreek) + buttermilk || 🕓 Snack: Cucumber sticks + carrot sticks + hummus/peanut chutney (2 tbsp) + green tea | Carotenoids + fibre || 🌙 Dinner: Vegetable soup (mixed sabzi, 1.5 cups, homemade, low salt) + 2 multigrain roti + paneer/egg bhurji | Light + high protein || 🌛 Bedtime: Warm milk + 1 tsp ashwagandha powder (if not on chemo; consult oncologist) + pinch nutmeg | Adaptogen for stress + sleep || 💧 HYDRATION: 30–35 ml/kg/day. Coconut water, nimbu pani (no sugar), chaas (buttermilk), herbal teas, jeera water, fennel water preferred. Limit sweet chai/coffee. || 🏃 EXERCISE [ESPEN B4-1/B4-2/C5-1]: 150–300 min/week moderate aerobic (brisk walk, yoga, cycling, swimming) + 2–3x/week resistance. Yoga beneficial for Indian BC survivors — reduces cortisol, improves QoL, flexibility. || Regional: Emphasise whole wheat chapati, bajra/jowar roti, dal, seasonal sabzi; reduce heavy ghee, cream, paneer excess; increase green leafy vegetables. || 💰 Upper-Middle SES: Can include quinoa, Greek yoghurt, salmon, organic produce. Focus on quality over quantity. Avoid over-supplementation. || 🌱 VEGETARIAN BC PATIENT: Complete protein strategy — dal+rice/roti at same meal (complementary AA), include rajma/chana/lentils daily, paneer/tofu/soya 1–2x/day, dahi 1–2 cups/day, sprouted legumes. B12 supplement if vegan. Omega-3: flaxseed + walnuts + algae-based DHA supplement. || ❌ STRICTLY AVOID [ALL INDIAN BC PATIENTS]: Alcohol, tobacco (paan/gutka), vanaspati/dalda (trans fats), excess ghee in obese patients, maida/refined flour products, packaged namkeen/biscuits, sugar-sweetened drinks (even fruit juice), raw/undercooked meat/eggs during chemo. || 🐟 OMEGA-3 FOR VEGETARIANS: Ground flaxseed (1–2 tbsp/day) + walnuts (5–7/day) + mustard oil for cooking + algae-based DHA supplement (250–500 mg/day) — essential since no fish intake. || 🏃 YOGA + EXERCISE [ESPEN B4-1/B4-2]: Brisk walk 45 min/day + yoga (reduces cortisol/fatigue, improves QoL in Indian BC survivors) + resistance 2–3x/week. Reduces BC recurrence risk significantly.
